# M0-S2: explicit file arguments run .lgo; mixed .go/.lgo arguments are rejected.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Explicit .lgo file runs.
logos run main.lgo
stdout '^cmdline ok$'

# Each mixed-test file runs alone, so the mixed failure below is not vacuous.
logos run a.go
stdout '^a ok$'

logos run b.lgo
stdout '^b ok$'

# Mixed .go and .lgo file arguments fail.
! logos run a.go b.lgo
stderr 'correctness::mixed_package'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cmdline

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("cmdline ok")
}

-- a.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("a ok")
}

-- b.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("b ok")
}
